Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: independent reusable physical monitor cutout for a tactile 2D animated film.
Create ONE beautiful desktop monitor, straight-on front view, on genuinely transparent background. Landscape canvas, monitor fills canvas with small transparent margin, stand and base fully visible. Large broad 16:10 dark plum blank display occupies most of the upper body, precise rounded display boundary. Substantial warm ivory paper casing with slightly asymmetric hand-cut contours, layered cardboard side backing peeking on right/bottom, a distinct thick lower lip, short stout muted teal pedestal and wide stable trapezoid foot. The screen is blank uninterrupted #241D29, no text, icons or reflections. Casing feels illustrated from layered printed paper with subtle dry gouache ink variation and fine sparse paper fibers, warm shadows at cut edges, three purposeful printed seam/edge marks. Flat cutout art, shallow depth only, sophisticated children's editorial illustration, broad shapes, restrained soft ink edges. Palette ivory #F4EBD8, tan #DCCDB3, deep charcoal #202C32, teal #318E85. No photorealism, no glossy 3D, no room, no desk, no characters, no labels, no cables, no lettering. The physical casing must feel designed and touchable, not a uniform vector rounded rectangle. Keep the screen unobstructed for later editable UI compositing.
